title: Feature Root: Fix AddItemSheet aisle picker selection not persisting
description: Shared execution root for the AddItemSheet aisle picker persistence bug fix, coordinating small implementation beads plus one shared testing, documentation, and review pass.
acceptance_criteria: AddItemSheet binds the aisle Picker directly to `$selectedAisle` and no longer uses a custom computed Binding wrapper.
Manual aisle picks persist after returning from the navigationLink picker sub-view and update the displayed chip consistently.
Programmatic aisle assignments from last-used defaulting and auto-detect do not mark the aisle as manually selected.
Manual aisle selection continues to block later auto-detect overrides, while successful auto-detect still sets its cue until the user manually changes the aisle.
Shared test, documentation, and review work cover the full feature after all implementation beads complete.
